title: Harden deployable release packaging
summary: Added strict deployable portable-ZIP staging, content privacy policy, manifest hashes/version identity, product runtime-root routing, copied-bundle acceptance gates, bootstrap redaction, and dependency review records.
reason: Prevent personal state, secrets, mutable runtime artifacts, missing runtime dependencies, and unproven open/close behavior from reaching a portable release.
behavior_before: Release ZIP staging lacked a deployable intent, file hashes, copied-bundle acceptance, and a single process-log runtime root.
behavior_after: Deployable builds require a compiled shell, source gate, clean ZIP verification, hash/version checks, and package-mode launch/close acceptance using product runtime roots.
manual_validation: Deployable build dry run passed with -Deployable -Zip -Verify -DryRun.
Focused Python runtime-root tests passed (17 tests).
rollback_plan: Remove -Deployable and PackageAcceptance call paths, restore previous runtime-root fallbacks, and delete only the new content-policy/identity checks; no released artifact or external deployment was mutated.
notes:
The workspace-wide rustfmt check remains blocked by unrelated pre-existing formatting drift in backend_contract/routes.rs, backend_contract.rs, and lib.rs. No full ZIP/open-close validation was run because this implementation task did not build a release candidate.
